remarks: Enjoy gorgeous city views from this bright, spacious and beautifully updated end-unit apartment featuring new floors, fresh paint, and an open floor plan. The modern kitchen boasts granite countertops and stainless steel appliances, while the large primary suite offers a walk-in closet. Highly desirable amenities include in-unit washer/dryer, zoned heating & cooling, and hot/cold water included in rent. The Windmere, a highly sought-after building, provides an excellent fitness center, secure entry, garage parking for 2 cars (tandem), and guest parking. All just a short walk to downtown Stamford's best dining, shopping, and entertainment!  Pets accepted with restrictions- up to 2 cats, or 1 dog under 75lbs, no aggressive breeds. Must meet HOA requirements as well. Any damage done by pet not considered normal wear and tear. One time $250 non-refundable pet rent. Don't miss out-schedule a tour today! Excellent credit, sufficient income and references required.
